arxiv-2112-10039.title: Wasserstein Generative Learning of Conditional Distribution
arxiv-2112-10039.creator: Shiao Liu Xingyu Zhou Yuling Jiao, Jian Huang
arxiv-2112-10039.description: Abstract Conditional distribution is a fundamental quantity for describing the relationship between a response and a predictor. We propose a Wasserstein generative approach to learning a conditional distribution. The proposed approach uses a conditional generator to transform a known distribution to the target conditional distribution.

arxiv-2310-11986.title: Sociotechnical Safety Evaluation of Generative AI Systems
arxiv-2310-11986.creator: Laura Weidinger, Maribeth Rauh, Nahema Marchal, Arianna Manzini, Lisa Anne Hendricks, Juan Mateos-Garcia, Stevie Bergman, Jackie Kay, Conor Griffin, Ben Bariach, Iason Gabriel, Verena Rieser, William Isaac
arxiv-2310-11986.description: Abstract Generative AI systems produce a range of risks. To ensure the safety of generative AI systems, these risks must be evaluated. In this paper, we make two main contributions toward establishing such evaluations. First, we propose a three-layered framework that takes a structured, sociotechnical approach to evaluating these risks.

arxiv-2504-21687.title: Heterogeneously error-corrected QRAMs
arxiv-2504-21687.creator: Ansh Singal, Kaitlin N. Smith
arxiv-2504-21687.description: Abstract Quantum Random Access Memory (QRAM) holds the promise of enabling several large scale applications of quantum computers. However, designing fault tolerant QRAMs for large scale applications is still an open problem due to the poor error and resource scaling of current architectures.

arxiv-2508-00893.title: Multi-Community Spectral Clustering for Geometric Graphs
arxiv-2508-00893.creator: Luiz Emilio Allem, Konstantin Avrachenkov, Carlos Hoppen, Hariprasad Manjunath, Lucas Siviero Sibemberg
arxiv-2508-00893.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider the soft geometric block model (SGBM) with a fixed number k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 of homogeneous communities in the dense regime, and we introduce a spectral clustering algorithm for community recovery on graphs generated by this model.

arxiv-2512-19106.title: Polyhedra of Constant Gaussian Curvature
arxiv-2512-19106.creator: Soto Hisakawa, Shizuo Kaji, Ryo Kawai
arxiv-2512-19106.description: Abstract Topology and geometry are deeply intertwined in the study of surfaces, though their interaction manifests differently in smooth and discrete settings. In the smooth category, a classical result asserts that any closed smooth surface embedded in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} with constant Gaussian curvature must be a sphere, reflecting the strong rigidity of differential geometry.

pmc-10603086.title: Practical N-to-C peptide synthesis with minimal protecting groups
pmc-10603086.creator: Toshifumi Tatsumi, Koki Sasamoto, Takuya Matsumoto, Ryo Hirano, Kazuki Oikawa, Masato Nakano, Masaru Yoshida, Kounosuke Oisaki, Motomu Kanai
pmc-10603086.description: Accessible drug modalities have continued to increase in number in recent years. Peptides play a central role as pharmaceuticals and biomaterials in these new drug modalities. Although traditional peptide synthesis using chain-elongation from C- to N-terminus is reliable, it produces large quantities of chemical waste derived from protecting groups and condensation reagents, which place a heavy burden on the environment.

pmc-11337708.title: Sensitivity of classification criteria from time of diagnosis in an incident systemic lupus erythematosus cohort: a population-based study from Norway
pmc-11337708.creator: Hilde Haukeland, Sigrid Reppe Moe, Cathrine Brunborg, Antonela Botea, Nenad Damjanic, Gro Årthun Wivestad, Heidi Kverneggen Øvreås, Thea Bjerkestrand Bøe, Anniken Orre, Garen Torhild, Helga Sanner, Karoline Lerang, Øyvind Molberg
pmc-11337708.description: ObjectivesTo compare the sensitivity of 2019 European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology/American College of Rheumatology (EULAR/ACR) classification criteria against 1997 ACR criteria for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), for incident SLE cases in the presumably complete population-based Nor-SLE cohort from Southeast Norway (2.9 million inhabitants).

pmc-11351021.title: Reinforcing Tunnel Network Exploration in Proteins Using Gaussian Accelerated Molecular Dynamics
pmc-11351021.creator: Nishita Mandal, Bartlomiej Surpeta, Jan Brezovsky
pmc-11351021.description: Tunnels are structural conduits in biomolecules responsible for transporting chemical compounds and solvent molecules from the active site. They have been shown to be present in a wide variety of enzymes across all functional and structural classes. However, the study of such pathways is experimentally challenging, because they are typically transient.

pmc-11433158.title: The Synergistic Effect of Calcained Coal-Series Kaolinite and Limestone on the Hydration of Portland Cement
pmc-11433158.creator: Jin Tang, Yue Yu, Yuanqing Bu, Bing Ma, Hao Zhou, Rong Zhou, Jiaqing Wang, Houhu Zhang, Danuta Barnat-Hunek, Francisco Agrela
pmc-11433158.description: Limestone calcined clay cement (LC3) presents a promising alternative material due to its reduced CO2 emissions and superior mechanical properties compared to traditional Portland cement (PC). This study investigates the synergistic effect of calcined coal-series kaolinite (CCK) and limestone (LS) on the hydration behavior of cement, specifically focusing on varying mass ratios.

pmc-11488246.title: Comprehensive analysis of PLATZ family genes and their responses to abiotic stresses in Barley
pmc-11488246.creator: Xue Feng, Gehao Zhu, Quan Meng, Jianbin Zeng, Xiaoyan He, Wenxing Liu
pmc-11488246.description: BackgroundPlant A/T-rich protein and zinc-binding protein (PLATZ) transcription factors are pivotal regulators in various aspects of plant biology, including growth, development, and responses to environmental stresses. While PLATZ genes have been extensively studied and functionally characterized in various plants, limited information is available for these genes in barley.

pmc-11489054.title: Gastrointestinal tract morphology, nutrient digestibility, and digesta mean retention time in laying hens of two different breeds fed with fine or coarse oat hulls
pmc-11489054.creator: Mochammad F Habibi, René P Kwakkel, Sonja de Vries
pmc-11489054.description: The inclusion of fiber-rich ingredients in poultry diets is expected to increase due to societal-, ecologic-, and economic developments. Particle size of dietary fiber sources, such as oat hulls (OH), has been shown to play a key-role in nutrient digestibility and digestion process, but the response may depend on the genetic background of the bird.

pmc-12390663.title: Integrating Serological and Genomic Data to Elucidate Lumpy Skin Disease Virus Diversity in Cattle from Bangladesh
pmc-12390663.creator: Nasrin Sultana Tonu, Sajedul Hayat, Shukes Chandra Badhy, Salima Ferdows, Md Golam Azam Chowdhury, Babu Kanti Nath, Md Safiul Alam Bhuiyan, Muhammad Jasim Uddin, Suman Das Gupta, Subir Sarker, Leyi Wang
pmc-12390663.description: Lumpy skin disease virus (LSDV), a transboundary pathogen threatening cattle health in South and Southeast Asia, presents growing challenges for disease control. This study combined serological, molecular, and genomic approaches to investigate LSDV in Barura Upazila, Bangladesh. Serological screening of 424 cattle using a commercial ELISA revealed a high seroprevalence of 55.5% (95% CI: 50.7–60.3), indicating widespread exposure.

pmc-12396377.title: ATG conjugation–dependent/independent mechanisms underlie lysosomal stress–induced TFEB regulation
pmc-12396377.creator: Shiori Akayama, Takayuki Shima, Tatsuya Kaminishi, Mengying Cui, Jlenia Monfregola, Kohei Nishino, Andrea Ballabio, Hidetaka Kosako, Tamotsu Yoshimori, Shuhei Nakamura
pmc-12396377.description: The authors show that TFEB is regulated by at least two different regulatory mechanisms during lysosomal damage: ATG conjugation system–dependent/independent regulation. The presence of two modes of regulation is further supported by the identification of novel regulators working in each mode.

pmc-12822212.title: Biochar and γ-Aminobutyric acid partnership improves rice productivity and mitigates Sb + Pb toxicity in co-contaminated soil
pmc-12822212.creator: Muhammad Aamer, Jiaen Zhang, Masood Iqbal Awan, Hui Wei, Farhan Nabi, Wenyun Huang, Ziqiang Liu, Xin Su, Shijie Liu, Rehab O Elnour, Mohamed Hashem
pmc-12822212.description: BackgroundAntimony (Sb) and lead (Pb) toxicities are serious threats to crop productivity, living organisms, and ecosystem sustainability. Thus, it is essential to find ways to reduce their entry into the environment to ensure safe and sustainable food production. Recently, biochar (BC) and signaling molecules have shown appreciable results in mitigating Sb and Pb toxicity.

pmc-13008688.title: L-kynurenine or nicotinamide supplementations mitigate uterine decidualization impairments during early pregnancy of uninephrectomized mice
pmc-13008688.creator: Yuye Wang, Qing Ma, Meitong Chen, Yukako Kayashima, Nobuyo Maeda-Smithies, Feng Li
pmc-13008688.description: Impaired renal reserve induced by unilateral nephrectomy (UNx) leads to the full-spectrum of phenotypes of preeclampsia (PE) in mice. L-kynurenine (a product of L-tryptophan metabolism) supplementation throughout the entire pregnancy rescues the PE-like phenotype in mice. However, whether UNx dams have endometrial decidualization deficiency during early pregnancy and whether L-kynurenine supplementation improve decidualization in UNx dams are not clear.

pmc-13221063.title: Integrated approach to model distribution and assess habitat suitability of killifish species in Oman’s local streams (wadis) under current and future climate conditions
pmc-13221063.creator: Aziza S. Al Adhoobi, Amna Al Ruheili, Saud M. Al Jufaili, Wenresti Gallardo, Daniel Silva, Daniel Silva, Daniel Silva
pmc-13221063.description: Freshwater ecosystems in arid regions possess extraordinary levels of biodiversity, yet they are subject to unprecedented pressures of climate change and anthropogenic activities. We employed an integrated approach of incorporating species distribution modeling (MaxEnt), habitat suitability modeling, and protected area analysis to assess conservation requirements for two endemic/native killifish (Aphaniops kruppi and A. stoliczkanus) in Oman’s freshwater ecosystems.

pmc-13262875.title: Influence of sociodemographic factors on the health literacy of individuals with mental disorders
pmc-13262875.creator: Eliana Elisa Rehfeld Gheno, Marcos Renan Barbosa, Andreia Catia Jorge Silva Costa, Eliane Schmidt, Arnaldo Nogaro, Adriane Cristina Bernat Kolankiewicz

pmc-13362942.title: Opioid prescribing trends in pain management clinics in Taiwan: 2008–2018: A population-based retrospective study
pmc-13362942.creator: Kwok-On Ng, Kun-Yu Kao, Chung-Han Ho, Chia-Hung Yu, Jhi-Joung Wang, Chin-Chen Chu
pmc-13362942.description: Pain management clinics (PMCs) play a central role in managing complex pain conditions, yet nationwide data on opioid prescription trends in this specialized setting remain limited. This study examined opioid prescribing patterns in Taiwanese PMCs from 2008 to 2018. This nationwide retrospective population-based study used data from the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database.

pmc-13554835.title: Current real-life survival after segmentectomy for lung cancer
pmc-13554835.creator: Xavier Cansouline, Abdoul-Khadry Gassama, Abdelhakim Elmraki, Béatrice Lipan, Damien Sizaret, Delphine Carmier, Antoine Legras

uslaw-usc-t42-s300ff1.title: 42 U.S.C. § 300ff–1 — Prohibition on use of funds
uslaw-usc-t42-s300ff1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s300ff1.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 6A (Public Health Service); Subchapter XXIV (Hiv Health Care Services Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. None of the funds made available under this Act, or an amendment made by this Act, shall be used to provide individuals with hypodermic needles or syringes so that such individuals may use illegal drugs.
